Account Warmup: Why It's Critical for Automation

Why warming up your Instagram account matters and how to do it properly before running any automation campaigns.

By ColdNerd Team · January 22, 2025 · 5 min read

If you've ever had an Instagram account restricted after starting outreach, the cause was almost certainly the same: too much activity, too fast, from an account Instagram didn't trust yet. Account warmup is how you build that trust.

What is account warmup?

Warmup is a period of gradually increasing, natural-looking activity on an account before you run campaigns at full volume. It teaches Instagram that the account is operated by a real person with normal behaviour patterns.

Why it matters

  • Fewer restrictions: accounts with a history of normal activity get more leeway.
  • Better deliverability: messages from trusted accounts are more likely to reach the primary inbox.
  • Longevity: a warmed-up account can run campaigns for months instead of days.

A simple 14-day warmup plan

Days 1–4: Look like a real user

Complete your profile, post 2–3 pieces of content, follow a handful of accounts in your niche and spend a few minutes a day scrolling, liking and watching Stories.

Days 5–9: Start engaging

Leave genuine comments, reply to Stories and start a small number of conversations — think 5–10 DMs per day, mostly with people who already know you.

Days 10–14: Ramp up gradually

Increase daily messages step by step. Keep an eye on warnings or "action blocked" notices; if you see one, pause for 24–48 hours and reduce volume.

Rule of thumb: never double your daily volume overnight. Small, steady increases are what keep accounts healthy.
